conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month by focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding high-quality scanner setups. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a balanced approach to potential returns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by stretching for growth, utilizing leverage and concentration. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged and high-beta exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30%, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta single names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and the NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
